taste:
This is a rich, savoury burger built around two thick, juicy beef patties and a double helping of melting American-style cheese. The beef supplies the substantial bite, while the cheese gives the stack a softer, richer texture. Crisp gherkins provide contrast, with tangy mustard cutting across the richness and ketchup adding another layer of flavour.

A soft toasted bun holds the tall stack together, so the emphasis is on a hearty burger rather than a restrained serving. Chips accompany it, and the dish is described as served fresh and hot. Choose it for classic diner flavours and a serious appetite, particularly if beef and cheese are your main reasons for ordering a burger.
